E1. No dead anchors — cmd: `grep -c 'href="#' src/components/money/MoneyDesk.tsx src/components/wallet/CardsPage.tsx src/components/cover/Compare.tsx src/components/cover/PolicyReader.tsx src/components/profile/ProfileView.tsx` — PASS if every file reports 0 (also `grep -rn 'href="#direct"' src` returns nothing).

E3. SoonButton unit shape — vitest `tests/components/soon-controls.test.tsx` "SoonButton renders contract": render `<SoonButton>Foo</SoonButton>`; PASS if element containing "Foo" has class `k-btn`, `aria-disabled="true"`, `title="Coming soon"`, and contains a trailing chip with text "Soon".

E4. SoonButton click inert — same file, "SoonButton click does nothing": render inside a `<form onSubmit={spy}>` and a wrapper with `onClick={spy}` capture-safe; `fireEvent.click` and `userEvent.click` on it; PASS if no throw, spy not called, no navigation (`window.location.href` unchanged), no state change in DOM (container innerHTML before == after).

E8. PolicyReader — "PolicyReader Read guide is Soon": PASS if control with text "Read guide" has `aria-disabled="true"` and `title="Coming soon"`.

E9. ProfileView — "ProfileView dead Add is Soon": PASS if the formerly dead "Add" control has `aria-disabled="true"` and `title="Coming soon"`; no remaining "Add" button without a handler or aria-disabled (every `getAllByRole('button', {name: /^Add/})` either is aria-disabled="true" or its click changes the DOM/calls a handler).
